name: 三界神话V1.50
group_note: 三界神话「紫藤分站」(San Jie Shen Hua, Zitengfen station edition), second of the 5-lib sjsh family cluster; different sub-branch content from sjsh (紫藤 vs 宝鸡) but shares the same core codebase. WASM pass fixed: (1) §7.60 master.lpc log_error()/standard_trace() -> CHANNEL_D mid-compile crash, guarded both with find_object(CHANNEL_D) -- present here, unlike sjsh where this specific lineage variant didn't have it. (2) Same 45-line corrupted-byte convertd.lpc table as sjsh, fixed with the identical byte-level script. (3) §7.61 message() simul_efun wrapper missing the exclude||({}) guard -- channeld.lpc's do_channel() (and other 3-arg message() callers) crashed with 'Bad argument 4 to EFUN message()' once CHANNEL_D successfully loaded after fix (1); this is the exact channeld.lpc call site AGENTS.md §7.61 already documents. (4) §7.41-class corrupted emoted.o, same catch(restore()) fix as sjsh. (5) §8.1-class is_chinese() byte-range bug plus an unusual manifestation of the unhalved-length-bound class: check_legal_name() used `i%2` as a parity gate assuming 2-byte GBK chars, which under this driver's UTF8 codepoint-per-character strings means 3-byte-per-char CJK names of ODD character count are always rejected (i%2 true) while EVEN counts coincidentally passed -- fixed both is_chinese() (codepoint range check) and check_legal_name()'s bound (1-6 chars matching the prompt text, dropped the i%2 gate). (6) A wizard-only-loopback registration gate (adm/daemons/sited.lpc's is_valid(), same shape as sje's) blocks even the literal 'new' registration keyword from 127.0.0.1 since wiz_level('new') is never true -- exempted 'new' specifically (alongside the lib's own pre-existing 'allenc' bootstrap exception), matching the established §1.3e loopback-testing-friction bypass class; genuinely new (non-wizlisted) player ids are still blocked from registering via WASM/localhost specifically, a real but narrow testing limitation, not fixed further since real remote deployments are unaffected (the loopback branch is never hit for non-local IPs). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist -- this account bypasses both the loopback id-gate (already a wizard) and the second is_valid() re-check inside the two-password (admin+regular) registration flow. Verified: full registration (new->id->name->admin-password->confirm->regular-password->confirm->email->gender->gift) -> enter world, permission displays (admin) correctly; default_trusted_write/default_exclude_write ACL tables also directly source-verified to grant (admin) unrestricted '/' write access. LPC formatter run across all 10310 files; reverted 2 files with confirmed CJK re-spacing corruption (same 2 files as sjsh, shared content) found via the same-text-despaced-matches-old-file scan across 113 formatter-touched files; also directly diff-reviewed the one map.lpc file present -- clean, cosmetic only. Post-formatter re-verified clean.
